projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: This StudioNet project tracks the public launch of ProofFund itself: a milestone funding protocol where capital remains in escrow until validators independently verify explicit acceptance criteria against public web evidence.
projects.summary: A live milestone escrow for public work, governed by evidence and appealable AI consensus.
projects.title: ProofFund Protocol Launch

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: An independent ProofFund pilot that publishes a searchable security atlas for widely used open-source packages. The work combines documented source selection, reproducible risk criteria, and public evidence so maintainers and downstream teams can inspect every finding.
projects.summary: Map reproducible security signals across critical open-source dependencies.
projects.title: Open Source Security Atlas

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: An independent public-data pilot that organizes high-value civic datasets around provenance, licensing, refresh cadence, and practical reuse. Every release is designed to be inspected through public URLs and evaluated against explicit completeness criteria.
projects.summary: Turn fragmented civic datasets into a documented, reusable public catalog.
projects.title: Civic Data Commons

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: A community infrastructure pilot for documenting environmental sensors, calibration status, coverage, and public data endpoints. The registry prioritizes provenance and reproducibility so validator review can separate operational sensors from unsupported claims.
projects.summary: Create an auditable registry for community-operated environmental sensors.
projects.title: Climate Sensor Registry

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: An open-source pilot focused on repeatable accessibility verification for product teams. The toolkit translates established accessibility guidance into documented checks, example fixtures, and a public execution path suitable for independent review.
projects.summary: Ship practical accessibility checks that teams can run before deployment.
projects.title: Accessible Web Toolkit

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: A research infrastructure pilot that evaluates the availability and usability of code, data, environment definitions, and execution instructions. The index publishes its rubric and evidence so every score can be challenged or independently repeated.
projects.summary: Score whether public research artifacts can be independently reproduced.
projects.title: Reproducibility Index

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: An archival pilot for organizing local public-interest reporting into a durable, searchable collection. It records original source, publication context, capture status, and topic metadata while respecting public access and provenance requirements.
projects.summary: Preserve and index public-interest local reporting with durable provenance.
projects.title: Local Journalism Archive

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: An education pilot that maps public learning credentials to skills, issuing requirements, evidence standards, and source documentation. The project emphasizes traceable claims rather than rankings, enabling independent verification of every mapping.
projects.summary: Make public learning credentials comparable through transparent mappings.
projects.title: Open Credential Map

projects.creator: 0x95803126315a05e642d8e46ce1d77ea2199a2a6e
projects.description: A humanitarian data pilot that organizes public logistics and access signals into a documented operational view. It focuses on source attribution, freshness, uncertainty, and clear limitations so decisions are grounded in inspectable evidence.
projects.summary: Track public logistics signals for faster, evidence-based aid coordination.
projects.title: Humanitarian Logistics Monitor

milestones.analysis: The supplied evidence is a GenLayerJS SDK repository and does not demonstrate a deployed StudioNet contract exposing the required project‑creation, escrow, milestone, consensus, dispute, reputation, and claim methods.
milestones.criteria: The deployed StudioNet contract exposes project creation, payable funding escrow, milestone evidence submission, consensus evaluation, bonded disputes, reputation, and claim methods in its public schema.
milestones.evidence_note: Public source repository documenting the implemented SDK, release history, installation path, and inspectable code used as delivery evidence.
